d:
Nitish Setu ko lekar patrakaron ne Nitish Kumar se saval kiya. is par unhonne javab dete hue kaha, 'aapke nam par pul bana hai.' patrakaron ke sath unki yah batchit kaimre men kaid ho gaee. aakhir saval kya tha aur Nitish Kumar ne kis sandarbh men yah javab diya? dekhie pura vidiyo.
About Channel:
ABP Bihar pradesh ki khabron ka ek aisa chainal hai jahan pradesh se juri har khabar aapke pas sabse pahle pahunchti hai. bihar ki rajniti, bihar ki barh, lalu - nitish ka ek dusre par palatvar, apradh ki andruni khabar aapke pas tathyon ke sath lekar aata hai.
